name: health-archive
description: Source-backed personal health archive for each signed-in user: query labs, medications, symptoms and vitals, and record quote-backed reports through an OAuth MCP connector.

interface.shortDescription: Query and record a source-backed personal health archive
interface.longDescription: Each person who signs in gets a private, source-backed health archive of lab results, clinical records, medications, symptoms, vitals and conversations. Answers are grounded in their records, and new reports are recorded as reviewed, quote-backed facts.
